notes.title: Release Sale
notes.content:
Congratulations! If you've made it here, you've found the world's premier bread sorting game, which is now officially released for both Oculus Rift and HTC Vive!

To celebrate mankind's greatest accomplishment since landing on the moon, 
Breadwinner will have a release sale for $2.99 - or the price of a loaf of bread!
